title: Derived mate transport under a common codomain isomorphism
statement: Choose derived categories of scheme modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $h:g\prime f=f\prime g$. For an isomorphism $e:S\cong A$ and a witness $h_A:g\prime(fe)=f\prime(ge)$, there is a natural isomorphism $a:Rf_*\,Lg^*\cong R(fe)_*\,L(ge)^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] such that $\beta(h)_E=a_E\,\beta(h_A)_E$ for all $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, with the pinned mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. The lower-left base $S\prime$ and the upper schemes are unchanged; the square need only commute.

proof.text: Use the selected pullback composition and identity isomorphisms to make L(e.hom) an equivalence with inverse L(e.inv). Adjointify the explicit equivalence without changing its functors; its adjunction adjV has invertible counit.

Conjugate c f e.hom under the adjunction for f e.hom and the composite of adjV with the pinned adjunction for f to get d:R(f e.hom) ≅ Rf followed by L(e.inv). Insert the inverse adjV counit before Lg, compose c g e.hom, then d.inv; this constructs a.

The private pullback_square_postcomp lemma obtains the comparison identity for q and qA from associativity and equality-transport naturality. The private common_equivalence_transport lemma uses qA naturality and the conjugate-counit identity to move d.inv next to the counit for f e.hom. The square comparison identity cancels c f e.hom. Naturality of q then places the inserted inverse equivalence counit next to its counit, and they cancel, leaving q followed by Lgprime of the f counit. Injectivity and naturality of the unchanged fprime Hom equivalence give the mate equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_derivedBaseChange_codomain_iso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    {A : Scheme.{u}} (e : S ≅ A)
    (hA : g' ≫ (f ≫ e.hom) = f' ≫ (g ≫ e.hom)) :
    ∃ a : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ e.hom) ⋙ derivedPullback (g ≫ e.hom),
      ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h E =
          a.hom.app E ≫
            schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (f ≫ e.hom) f' (g ≫ e.hom) g' hA E
